      Manage Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise licenses<devsite-actions hidden data-nosnippet><devsite-feature-tooltip

<aside class="special"><strong>Important:</strong><span> This page discusses access to Gemini Code Assist using a
Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise license. Consumer account
access to Gemini Code Assist features, such as through
Gemini Code Assist for individuals,
<a href="https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/deprecations/code-assist-individuals">has been deprecated</a>.</span></aside>
<p>Before using Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise, each user in
your organization needs a license.</p>

<p>By default, automatic license assignment is enabled for all subscriptions.
Users in your organization with the required permissions are automatically
assigned a license when they start using Gemini Code Assist in a
supported IDE. Those permissions are detailed later in this document. After you
set up Gemini Code Assist, you can choose to assign licenses
<a href="#manual">manually</a> or continue with <a href="#automatic">automatic</a> assignment.</p>

<p>You can assign licenses to any users that have access to a project linked to the
relevant <a href="/billing/docs/how-to/manage-billing-account">billing account</a>.</p>

<h2 id="before_you_begin" data-text="Before you begin" tabindex="-1">Before you begin</h2>

<ul>
<li><p>Ensure that you have the Billing Account Administrator
(<a href="/billing/docs/how-to/billing-access#billing.admin"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">roles/billing.admin</code></a>)
or Consumer Procurement Order Administrator
(<a href="/marketplace/docs/access-control#consumerprocurement.orderAdmin"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">roles/consumerprocurement.orderAdmin</code></a>)
IAM roles so that you can grant additional permissions
required on the billing account for specific license management tasks
detailed in the following sections.</p></li>
<li><p>Verify you have <a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/set-up-gemini">set up Gemini Code Assist</a>.</p></li>
<li><p>If you want to manage licenses using an API rather than the Google Cloud console,
then verify the following:</p>

<ul>
<li>Set up a <a href="/docs/quotas/quota-project">quota project</a> for
your billing account.</li>
<li>Enable the
<a href="/marketplace/docs/reference/consumerprocurement/rest">Cloud Commerce Consumer Procurement API</a>
in your quota project.</li>
<li>Verify the following header key-value pairs are present on all API calls:
<ul>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">Authorization</code>: your
<a href="/sdk/gcloud/reference/auth/print-access-token">Google Cloud access token</a>
from the Google Cloud CLI</li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">x-goog-user-project</code>: the project ID of your quota project</li>
</ul></li>
</ul></li>
</ul>

<h2 id="change-licenses" data-text="Change the number of Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise licenses in a subscription" tabindex="-1">Change the number of Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise licenses in a subscription</h2>

<p>You can add or remove the number of Gemini Code Assist licenses
directly through the Google Cloud console, or through your Google account
representative or an authorized reseller.</p>

<p>To change the number of licenses in a subscription, follow these steps:</p>

<ol>
<li><p>Verify that you have the following Identity and Access Management (IAM)
permissions on the billing account that owns the subscription:</p>

<ul>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">billing.accounts.get</code></li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">consumerprocurement.orders.get</code></li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">consumerprocurement.orders.modify</code></li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">resourcemanager.projects.get</code></li>
</ul></li>
<li><p>In the Google Cloud console, go to the <strong>Admin for Gemini</strong> page.</p>

<p><a href="https://console.cloud.google.com/gemini-admin" target="console" class="button button-primary">Go to Admin for Gemini</a> </p></li>
<li><p>Choose the subscription that you want to change, and then select
<strong>Modify Subscription</strong>.</p></li>
<li><p>Enter the number of licenses that you want to have. The following information
is displayed:</p>

<ul>
<li>Number of total licenses after purchase.</li>
<li>Number of licenses available for assignment after purchase.</li>
<li>New subscription price per term. The additional amount for the added
licenses is prorated based on how much time remains in the current
term.</li>
</ul></li>
<li><p>Select <strong>Save</strong>.</p></li>
</ol>

<h2 id="view-licenses" data-text="View Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise license assignments" tabindex="-1">View Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise license assignments</h2>

<p>Select one of the following options:</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="console" data-text=" Console " tabindex="-1"> Console </h3><ol>
<li><p>Verify that you have the following IAM permissions on the
billing account that owns the subscription:</p>

<ul>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">billing.accounts.get</code></li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">consumerprocurement.orders.get</code></li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">consumerprocurement.licensePools.get</code></li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">consumerprocurement.licensePools.enumerateLicensedUsers</code></li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">resourcemanager.projects.get</code></li>
</ul></li>
<li><p>Go to the <strong>Admin for Gemini</strong> page and select the project attached to your
billing account with the Gemini Code Assist Standard or
Enterprise subscription.</p>

<p><a href="https://console.cloud.google.com/gemini-admin" target="console" class="button button-primary">Go to Admin for Gemini</a> </p></li>
<li><p>Choose the subscription that you want to change, and then select
<strong>Modify Subscription</strong>.</p>

<p>The following information is available for each user that has been assigned
a license:</p>

<ul>
<li>Name.</li>
<li>Email.</li>
<li>Date the license was assigned.</li>
<li>Date and time the license was last used.</li>
</ul></li>
<li><p>To find a specific set of users, you can filter and sort the list as
follows:</p>

<ul>
<li>To filter the list, in the <strong>Filter</strong> field,
enter the properties and values.</li>
<li>To sort the list, select the heading of the column that you want to sort
by. For example, to sort alphabetically by the user names, select the
<strong>Name</strong> column heading.</li>
</ul></li>
</ol></section>
<section><h3 id="api" data-text="API" tabindex="-1">API</h3><p>To view Gemini Code Assist Standard or Enterprise license
assignments, use the
<a href="/marketplace/docs/reference/consumerprocurement/rest/v1/billingAccounts.orders.licensePool/enumerateLicensedUsers"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">billingAccounts.orders.licensePool.enumerateLicensedUsers</code> method</a>.</p>

<ol>
<li><p>Verify that you have the
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">consumerprocurement.licensePools.enumerateLicensedUsers</code>
IAM permission on the billing account that contains
the license pool whose license assignments you want to view.</p></li>
<li><p>Use <a href="http://curl.haxx.se/"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">cURL</code></a> to call the method:</p>

<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded>curl -X GET \
-H "Authorization: Bearer $(gcloud auth print-access-token)" \
-H "X-Goog-User-Project: <var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var>" \
"https://cloudcommerceconsumerprocurement.googleapis.com/v1/billingAccounts/<var translate="no">BILLING_ACCOUNT_ID</var>/orders/<var translate="no">ORDER_ID</var>/licensePool:enumerateLicensedUsers/"
</pre></devsite-code>

<p>Replace the following:</p>

<ul>
<li><var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var>: the ID for a project. Quota usage and charges
associated with the API request are applied against this project.</li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">BILLING_ACCOUNT_ID</var></code>: the ID for the
billing account associated with the license pool.</li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">ORDER_ID</var></code>: the order ID. If you don&#39;t know
the order ID, you can retrieve it by
<a href="https://cloud.google.com/marketplace/docs/reference/consumerprocurement/rest/v1/billingAccounts.orders/list">listing the orders associated with your billing account</a>.</li>
</ul></li>
</ol>

<p>If the command succeeds, it returns <code translate="no" dir="ltr">licensedUsers</code> output in the following
format:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-disable-click-to-copy devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded><code translate="no" dir="ltr">{
  &#34;licensedUsers&#34;: [
      {
          &#34;username&#34;: &#34;dana@example.com&#34;,
          &#34;assignTime&#34;: &#34;2024-09-26T16:24:40.559222Z&#34;
      },
      {
          &#34;username&#34;: &#34;lee@example.com&#34;,
          &#34;assignTime&#34;: &#34;2024-09-26T16:24:40.559222Z&#34;
      },
      {
          &#34;username&#34;: &#34;taylor@example.com&#34;,
          &#34;assignTime&#34;: &#34;2024-09-26T16:24:40.559222Z&#34;
      },
      {
          &#34;username&#34;: &#34;bola@example.com&#34;,
          &#34;assignTime&#34;: &#34;2024-09-26T16:24:14.610828Z&#34;
      }
  ]
}
</code></pre></devsite-code>
<p>If there are no Gemini Code Assist Standard or Enterprise
license assignments or the <code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">ORDER_ID</var></code> is invalid, it
returns <code translate="no" dir="ltr">licensedUsers</code> output in the following format:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-disable-click-to-copy devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded><code translate="no" dir="ltr">{}
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
</devsite-selector></div>
<h2 id="automatic" data-text="Automatically assign Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise licenses" tabindex="-1">Automatically assign Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise licenses</h2>

<p>You can enable automatic license assignment for a subscription.</p>

<p>Automatic license assignment is only supported in VS Code, IntelliJ, and other
<a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/supported-languages#supported_ides">supported JetBrains IDEs</a>.</p>

<p>If you choose to automatically assign licenses for
Gemini Code Assist Standard or Enterprise, you can&#39;t remove or
add individual user licenses under that account. Users with license assignments
who haven&#39;t used any Gemini Code Assist Standard or Enterprise
features are automatically de-provisioned at the end of the inactivity period
set by the administrator.</p>

<ol>
<li><p>In the Google Cloud console, go to the <strong>Admin for Gemini</strong> page.</p>

<p><a href="https://console.cloud.google.com/gemini-admin" target="console" class="button button-primary">Go to Admin for Gemini</a> </p></li>
<li><p>Select <strong>Manage Gemini Code Assist</strong>, and then select <strong>Manage
Subscription</strong>.</p></li>
<li><p>Select <strong>License Management</strong>, and then select
<strong>Enable Automatic License Assignment</strong>. The <strong>Enable automatic licenses</strong>
dialog appears.</p>

<p>Switching this subscription to automatically assign licenses turns off
manual license assignment after the change, but pre-existing license
assignments are unaffected.</p></li>
<li><p>Set the length of time for a license to unassign if the assignee is inactive,
then select <strong>Confirm Change</strong>. The <strong>Automatic license assignment has been
enabled</strong> dialog appears.</p>

<p>If you configured <code translate="no" dir="ltr">T</code> days of inactivity for unassignment, then
license(s) are automatically unassigned and available in the license pool on
day <code translate="no" dir="ltr">T+1</code>. For example, if you configure <code translate="no" dir="ltr">7</code> days of inactivity for
unassignment, then the license(s) are unassigned and available in the license
pool on day <code translate="no" dir="ltr">8</code>.</p></li>
<li><p>Select <strong>Close</strong>.</p></li>
<li><p>Make sure you
<a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/set-up-gemini#grant-iam">grant the Gemini for Google Cloud User and Service Usage Consumer IAM roles to users</a>
to the licensed
users.</p>

<p>Users with the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">cloudaicompanion.licenses.selfAssign</code> permission
automatically receive a license when they first access
Gemini Code Assist Standard or Enterprise in a project paid by
a billing account that has a valid subscription that is configured for
automatic license assignment and has available licenses covered by your
subscriptions in the billing account.</p></li>
</ol>

<p>To disable automatic license assignment, follow these steps:</p>

<ol>
<li><p>In the Google Cloud console, go to the <strong>Admin for Gemini</strong> page.</p>

<p><a href="https://console.cloud.google.com/gemini-admin" target="console" class="button button-primary">Go to Admin for Gemini</a> </p></li>
<li><p>Select <strong>Manage Gemini Code Assist</strong>, and then select <strong>Manage Subscription</strong>.</p></li>
<li><p>Select <strong>License Management</strong>, and then select <strong>Manage Automatic License
Assignment</strong>. The <strong>Manage automatic license assignment</strong> dialog appears.</p></li>
<li><p>Select <strong>Disable automatic license management</strong>.</p></li>
<li><p>Select <strong>Confirm change</strong>.</p></li>
</ol>

<h2 id="manual" data-text="Manually assign Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise licenses to individual users" tabindex="-1">Manually assign Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise licenses to individual users</h2>

<p>With manual license assignment, you can add and remove licenses for individual
users. This method gives you direct control over who can access
Gemini Code Assist, which is ideal for granting access to a
specific set of users.</p>

<p>Select one of the following options:</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="console_1" data-text=" Console " tabindex="-1"> Console </h3><ol>
<li><p>Verify that you have the following IAM permissions on the
billing account that owns the subscription:</p>

<ul>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">billing.accounts.get</code></li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">consumerprocurement.orders.get</code></li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">consumerprocurement.licensePools.get</code></li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">consumerprocurement.licensePools.enumerateLicensedUsers</code></li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">consumerprocurement.licensePools.assign</code></li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">resourcemanager.projects.get</code></li>
</ul></li>
<li><p>Go to the <strong>Admin for Gemini</strong> page.</p>

<p><a href="https://console.cloud.google.com/gemini-admin" target="console" class="button button-primary">Go to Admin for Gemini</a> </p></li>
<li><p>Select <strong>Manage Gemini Code Assist</strong>, and then select
<strong>Modify Subscription</strong>.</p></li>
<li><p>For this Gemini Code Assist Standard or Enterprise
subscription, verify that you set <strong>License Assignment</strong> to <strong>Manually
Assign Licenses</strong>. If the Gemini Code Assist Standard or
Enterprise subscription is set to <strong>Automatically Assign Licenses</strong>, then
you cannot manage individual licenses. Switching this billing account to
<strong>Manually Assign Licenses</strong> turns off automatic license assignment after
the change, but pre-existing license assignments are unaffected.</p></li>
<li><p>Select <strong>Add licensed user</strong>. A user selection dialog appears. Only
individual Google Account email addresses are supported, such as
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">@gmail.com</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">@googlegroups.com</code>, and Google Workspace domains.
Workforce Identity Federation (BYOID) is not supported.</p></li>
<li><p>Select <strong>Add licensed user</strong>.</p></li>
<li><p>Verify that you
<a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/set-up-gemini#grant-iam">grant the Gemini for Google Cloud User and Service Usage Consumer IAM roles to users</a>
to the licensed users.</p></li>
</ol></section>
<section><h3 id="api_1" data-text="API" tabindex="-1">API</h3><p>To assign Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise licenses,
use the
<a href="/marketplace/docs/reference/consumerprocurement/rest/v1/billingAccounts.orders.licensePool/assign"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">billingAccounts.orders.licensePool.assign</code> method</a>.</p>

<ol>
<li>Verify that you have the following IAM permissions
on the billing account that contains the license pool whose license you
intend to assign:</li>
</ol>

<ul>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">billing.accounts.get</code></li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">consumerprocurement.licensePools.assign</code></li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">consumerprocurement.licensePools.get</code></li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">consumerprocurement.licensePools.unassign</code></li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">consumerprocurement.orders.get</code></li>
</ul>

<ol>
<li><p>Create a JSON file that contains the following information:</p>

<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded>
{
  "usernames": [
    <var translate="no">USER_EMAILS</var>
  ]
}
</pre></devsite-code>

<p>Replace <code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">USER_EMAILS</var></code> with a comma-separated list of
user accounts that are being assigned the license—for example,
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">&quot;dana@example.com&quot;, &quot;lee@example.com&quot;</code>. Only individual Google Account
email addresses are supported, such as <code translate="no" dir="ltr">@gmail.com</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">@googlegroups.com</code>,
and Google Workspace domains. Workforce Identity Federation (BYOID) is
not supported.</p></li>
<li><p>Use <a href="http://curl.haxx.se/"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">cURL</code></a> to call the method:</p>

<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded>curl -X POST --data-binary @<var translate="no">JSON_FILE_NAME</var> \
-H "Authorization: Bearer $(gcloud auth print-access-token)" \
-H "X-Goog-User-Project: <var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var>" \
-H "Content-Type: application/json" \
"https://cloudcommerceconsumerprocurement.googleapis.com/v1/billingAccounts/<var translate="no">BILLING_ACCOUNT_ID</var>/orders/<var translate="no">ORDER_ID</var>/licensePool:assign/"</pre></devsite-code>

<p>Replace the following:</p>

<ul>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">JSON_FILE_NAME</var></code>: the path for the JSON
file that you created in Step 2.</li>
<li><var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var>: the ID for a project. Quota usage and charges
associated with the API request are applied against this project.</li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">BILLING_ACCOUNT_ID</var></code>: the ID for the
billing account associated with the license pool.</li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">ORDER_ID</var></code>: the order ID. If you don&#39;t know
the order ID, you can retrieve it by
<a href="https://cloud.google.com/marketplace/docs/reference/consumerprocurement/rest/v1/billingAccounts.orders/list">listing the orders associated with your billing account</a>.</li>
</ul></li>
</ol>

<p>If successful, the response is similar to the following:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-disable-click-to-copy devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded><code translate="no" dir="ltr">{}
</code></pre></devsite-code>
<p>To verify the assignment, <a href="#view-licenses">view the list of assignments</a>.</p>

<p>Then, verify that you
<a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/set-up-gemini#grant-iam">grant the Gemini for Google Cloud User and Service Usage Consumer IAM roles to users</a>
to the licensed users.</p></section>
</devsite-selector></div>
<h2 id="unassign-licenses" data-text="Manually unassign Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise licenses" tabindex="-1">Manually unassign Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise licenses</h2>

<p>Select one of the following options:</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="console_2" data-text=" Console " tabindex="-1"> Console </h3><ol>
<li><p>Verify that you have the following IAM permissions on the
billing account that owns the subscription:</p>

<ul>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">billing.accounts.get</code></li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">consumerprocurement.orders.get</code></li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">consumerprocurement.licensePools.get</code></li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">consumerprocurement.licensePools.enumerateLicensedUsers</code></li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">consumerprocurement.licensePools.unassign</code></li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">resourcemanager.projects.get</code></li>
</ul></li>
<li><p>Go to the <strong>Admin for Gemini</strong> page.</p>

<p><a href="https://console.cloud.google.com/gemini-admin" target="console" class="button button-primary">Go to Admin for Gemini</a> </p></li>
<li><p>Select <strong>Manage Gemini Code Assist</strong>, and then select <strong>Manage Subscription</strong>.</p></li>
<li><p>Select <strong>License Management</strong>, and then select <strong>Manage Automatic License
Assignment</strong>. The <strong>Manage automatic license assignment</strong> dialog appears.</p></li>
<li><p>Select the users for which you want to unassign licenses, then select
<strong>Unassign License</strong>.</p></li>
<li><p>Select <strong>Confirm</strong>.</p></li>
</ol></section>
<section><h3 id="api_2" data-text="API" tabindex="-1">API</h3><p>To unassign Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise
licenses, use the
<a href="/marketplace/docs/reference/consumerprocurement/rest/v1/billingAccounts.orders.licensePool/unassign"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">billingAccounts.orders.licensePool.unassign</code> method</a>.</p>

<ol>
<li><p>To perform this task, you must have the
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">consumerprocurement.licensePools.unassign</code> Identity and Access Management (IAM)
permission on the billing account that contains the license pool whose
license you intend to unassign.</p></li>
<li><p>Create a JSON file that contains the following information:</p>

<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded>
{
  "usernames": [
    <var translate="no">USER_EMAILS</var>
  ]
}
</pre></devsite-code>

<p>Replace <code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">USER_EMAILS</var></code> with a comma-separated list of
user accounts that are assigned the license—for example,
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">&quot;dana@example.com&quot;, &quot;lee@example.com&quot;</code>.</p></li>
<li><p>Use <a href="http://curl.haxx.se/"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">cURL</code></a> to call the method:</p>

<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded>curl -X POST --data-binary @<var translate="no">JSON_FILE_NAME</var> \
-H "Authorization: Bearer $(gcloud auth print-access-token)" \
-H "X-Goog-User-Project: <var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var>" \
-H "Content-Type: application/json" \
"https://cloudcommerceconsumerprocurement.googleapis.com/v1/billingAccounts/<var translate="no">BILLING_ACCOUNT_ID</var>/orders/<var translate="no">ORDER_ID</var>/licensePool:unassign/"</pre></devsite-code>

<p>Replace the following:</p>

<ul>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">JSON_FILE_NAME</var></code>: the path for the JSON
file that you created in Step 2.</li>
<li><var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var>: the ID for a project. Quota usage and charges
associated with the API request are applied against this project.</li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">BILLING_ACCOUNT_ID</var></code>: the ID for the
billing account associated with the license pool.</li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">ORDER_ID</var></code>: the order ID. If you don&#39;t know
the order ID, you can retrieve it by
<a href="https://cloud.google.com/marketplace/docs/reference/consumerprocurement/rest/v1/billingAccounts.orders/list">listing the orders associated with your billing account</a>.</li>
</ul></li>
</ol>

<p>If successful, the response is similar to the following:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-disable-click-to-copy devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded><code translate="no" dir="ltr">{}
</code></pre></devsite-code>
<p>To verify the unassignment, <a href="#view-licenses">view the list of assignments</a>.</p></section>
</devsite-selector></div>
<h2 id="transfer-licenses" data-text="Transfer Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise licenses" tabindex="-1">Transfer Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise licenses</h2>

<p>Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise licenses cannot be
transferred directly between users. Instead,
<a href="#unassign-licenses">unassign the license</a> from a user and then
<a href="#manual">assign a license</a> to the new user.</p>

<h2 id="prevent_cross-organization_license_usage" data-text="Prevent cross-organization license usage" tabindex="-1">Prevent cross-organization license usage</h2>

<p>Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise licenses are assigned
to individual users, not organizations or projects, allowing individual users to
use Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise across multiple
organizations.</p>

<p>Any
<a href="/gemini/docs/log-gemini">logs generated from Gemini Code Assist</a>
usage sit with the project in which the usage occurred, and not with the
licensee. Additionally, any customization or configuration of
Gemini Code Assist (such as
<a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/code-customization">code customization</a>)
is done on the project, not at the license or subscription level.</p>

<p>To further prevent cross-organization usage of Gemini Code Assist
Standard and Enterprise in a project, you can do one of the following:</p>

<ul>
<li>Disable the Gemini for Google Cloud API in the project.</li>
<li>Use permissions to deny user access to the project.</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="limitations" data-text="Limitations" tabindex="-1">Limitations</h2>

<ul>
<li>Gemini Code Assist license management does not support
<a href="/iam/docs/federated-identity-supported-services">Workforce Identity Federation</a>.</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="whats_next" data-text="What's next" tabindex="-1">What's next</h2>

<ul>
<li>Learn how to <a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/cross-org-license-usage">help prevent cross-organization license usage</a>.
